backtest.text: Backtest (run in 2013–2019 on every filer's data as of then, 2,274 outcomes, without analysts' consensus): the 80% range of revenue three years out held 80% of what happened (11% fell below it, 9% above) — about right. That is with every regime's growth spread × 1.5, the one number fitted on these outcomes (and used here): as the hidden Markov model estimates them, the range held 68% (18% below, 14% above) — a single year's regime spread understates how far revenue can drift over several.
